description: Screen manifest for the SolarOps UI catalog, captured by scripts/capture-screens.mjs. A screen has: id, title, macro (one-line purpose), detail (key controls/modals), group (catalog section). Reaching the screen: `noAuth:true` + `open` ({path,query}) for pre-login screens; otherwise `view` jumps via localStorage['solarflow_current_view'] after logging in. Optional `pre` runs actions before the shot: {clickText}, {click:selector}, {wait:ms}. Keep in sync with Layout.tsx allNavItems.

screens.title: LL Board (lead funnel)
screens.macro: The Trello lead funnel: every lead from intake to closed.
screens.detail: Jobs viewMode 'tryout'. Columns are drawn from the Conexsol Florida Services Trello board itself (GET /api/trello-card?lists=1): Trello's order, Trello's names, and any list added on Trello appears as a column. An archived list keeps its column only while it holds cards; cards whose column is gone land in a trailing 'Not on the Trello board' bucket. Only funnel cards (pipelineStage, no woNumber) appear; real service orders live on the main board. Cards show Trello label chips and the lead's import date. Clicking a customerless card opens LeadPanel.

screens.title: LL LeadPanel (Trello lead)
screens.macro: Working one Trello lead: labels, the source screenshot, contact fields, log actions, Move to Client.
screens.detail: Opened by clicking a customerless card on the LL board. The 'Source screenshot from Trello' block streams the card's first image through GET /api/trello-card?image= (signed-in, nothing stored, since customer-files is public). Targets the Trello lead 'Shunacee Hicks' because a lead migrated from the old Lead Lobby has no card and shows no screenshot; if Hicks is converted, point clickText at another Trello lead.

screens.title: Service order: Send to Trello
screens.macro: Creating Anthony's follow-up card for a service order from inside the order.
screens.detail: Next to Labels on the service order panel. Opens a picker of the Florida Trello board's open columns (preselects the order's own column, else Needs follow-Up Service) and a preview of the card title. The server creates the card with a 'SolarOps ref:' last line so the webhook and nightly sweep never import it as a lead; once sent the button becomes 'Open in Trello'. Targets the order 'Wisdom Anwana'; if that order is archived, point clickText at another.

screens.title: Dispatch Map
screens.macro: All active work orders plotted on a map.
screens.detail: DispatchMap. Geocodes WO addresses (OSM/Nominatim) and plots colored pins + schedule-order route panel. Foundation for agentic route optimization (Google Maps Routes API).

screens.title: Billing (Kanban)
screens.macro: Daniel's billing pipeline board, New through Costs Covered.
screens.detail: Billing kanban. 7 columns: New (Create Quote) - Quote Sent (Awaiting Approval / Approved) - Pending Completion - Ready to Invoice - Invoiced - Paid - Costs Covered. Drag a card to advance it. Aging markers: left stripe + day pill escalating every 3 days (amber 3-5, orange 6-8, red 9+), a ~ prefix means the age was inferred from last update. Each header has an N aging badge that filters the column. Clicking a card opens ServiceOrderPanel over the board.
